entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thanks for holding. My name is Mike. How can I help you today?
Hi Mike, I need to start a return for my VeloBand Pulse. I got it about a month ago, and the pulse rate seems really inaccurate. I just don't want it anymore.
Oh, I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with it, but that's absolutely no problem. You're well within the 90 days, so we can definitely get that returned for you.
Oh, great. So you can just process the return?
Yes, of course. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to the email we have on file for you right now. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off.

You're very welcome. And I see here you're a VIP member with us. As a little thank you for your loyalty, I've just added a credit for free 2-day shipping on your next VeloFit order. Will there be anything else today?
Wow, I appreciate that. No, just getting that return label is all I needed. Thanks, Mike.
It's my pleasure. You should see that email shortly. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
